gripOrHq.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

gripOrHq.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.
